source.title: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
source.text: Z.ai is moving its flagship GLM-5.4 model to a loop architecture in which 28 layers run twice, which the company says lets the 750-billion-parameter model match models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters. Benchmark scores are only available for a smaller 30B test model so far, and Z.ai is positioning GLM-5.4 as the start of "Generalized Coding," where code also generates videos, games, and CAD models. The article Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model appeared first on The Decoder .
